$comment: Icon system config: the single place the icon set is decided. Semantic app name -> Lucide icon name. Change a row and run `npm run icons:font` to regenerate the glyph map + copy the bundled font, the same way design/tokens.json drives the type system. Icons are Lucide (https://lucide.dev, ISC), rendered as a FONT rather than SVG (react-native-svg is banned here: it throws synchronouslyUpdateUIProps inside Reanimated views and kills touch, and our Icon sits inside animated Pressables everywhere). A font glyph is plain <Text> — safe in Reanimated, tinted by `color`, scaled by `fontSize`. Amit's call (wave-3): Lucide across the app for its clean, consistent stroke. The font ships from the `lucide-static` package (its prebuilt lucide.ttf, renamed to the `Lucide` family); Lucide's stroke is baked into the glyph, so the on-device weight is Lucide's own rather than a runtime 2.25 — the closest a static font can get.

glyphs.$comment: semantic name in the app -> Lucide icon name (https://lucide.dev/icons). The generator fails if a name is not in lucide-static's codepoints.json.
glyphs.$badgeCheckNote: The certified badge on a directory card (Amit, 2026-09-08: "certified icon should be like clarity.. lucide deosnthav eit or what?" — it does). Lucide's `badge-check` is the scalloped rosette with a check inside, which is the mark Clarity and Astrotalk both use. Drawn as ONE glyph in the accent rather than as our own check inside an accent disc, which is what it was first built as: two shapes stacked to approximate a shape the icon set already had. Outline rather than the references' solid fill, because every other mark in this app is Lucide outline and one filled badge would read as a different system.
glyphs.speaker: volume-2
